About us

Safety is a partnership built over time

We started in 2019 with a simple idea: a local security company can be as professional as the largest ones, with more closeness and care.

  • 2019Founded in Stockholm
  • 24/7Availability

How we think

Presence that makes a real difference

To us, security isn't only about spotting what goes wrong. It's about being the link that makes people feel seen, protected and respected. Since 2019 we have built trust by never compromising on care, whether we protect a shop, a home or an entire property.

About us

A journey that shaped the industry

  1. 2019

    The company is founded

    Swedbevakningstjänster AB starts with a clear vision: to raise the standard of what a local security company can deliver. The client was at the centre from day one, as a partner rather than just a customer.

  2. 2020

    Authorisation and professional growth

    We became an authorised security company with F-tax and VAT registration: a promise to deliver at the level of the big players, with the closeness of a smaller company.

  3. 2022

    Expansion and long-term partnerships

    Recurring agreements with property owners, retail chains and public bodies across Stockholm County. Physical guarding combined with strategic advice.

  4. 2024

    New markets

    Specialised consulting and investigation services were added, and we established operations in Malmö and Gothenburg.

  5. Today

    Setting the standard

    We grow steadily and take assignments nationwide. Local presence, national reach and personal commitment go hand in hand.
